meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 把每个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作一名 agent，加入同一份 markdown 会议文件（默认 ~/.claude-mem/STANDUP.md），分轮讨论后产出一份合并计划：目标 worktree、合并顺序与冲突处理。全程只读，不提交不合并，合并交给 /do。
howto.when: 当你要求跨 worktree、分支或 PR 做 standup、比较改动并给出统一合并计划时触发；没指定时间窗会先问你要哪个（1h、4h、24h 等）。候选只有 0 或 1 个时，它会说明这不构成 standup。

say.text: 帮我给最近 4 小时活跃的 worktree 开个 standup
say.note: 它们会加入同一份会议文件，分轮发言

say.text: 把这两个分支和这个 PR 拉进 standup，比一比改了什么
say.note: 全程只读，最后给出合并计划

say.text: 把 standup 的结论用人话讲给我，需要我拍板的决定列出来
say.note: 清楚的选项会用 AskUserQuestion 问你

howto.what_en: Each git worktree, branch, or PR joins one shared markdown room (default ~/.claude-mem/STANDUP.md) as an agent. Claude runs rounds, then writes one plan: target worktree, merge order, conflicts. Read-only; merges go to /do.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a standup across worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and get one plan. No window given: it asks (1h/4h/24h). Under 2 candidates, it says that isn't a standup.

say_en.text: Run a standup on worktrees active in the last 4 hours.
say_en.note: They join the shared room and talk in rounds.

say_en.text: Pull these two branches and this PR into a standup.
say_en.note: Read-only; ends with a consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Translate the standup outcome in plain language and list my calls.
say_en.note: It uses AskUserQuestion for the clear-cut ones.
